expectations.text: The plan counts only A-grade conversations (problem, decision influence, agreed next step) toward the threshold and reports B-grade separately
expectations.evidence: "Minimum: 45 A over 3 days" and "A count vs 45, B count as warm interest, scans as activity."

expectations.text: The plan defines success as a count of conversations where the attendee has the problem and agrees to a named next step
expectations.evidence: Grade A = "has a cost-visibility problem now... and agreed a named next step."

expectations.text: The plan says scan counts are reported as activity beside the qualified-conversation count, not as the result
expectations.evidence: "Scans are reported beside it as activity."

expectations.text: The plan's scan or consent line states the purpose of the follow-up rather than promising the data is used for nothing else
expectations.evidence: "I'll send the setup we sketched, and our team will follow up about the trial." and "Never promise 'nothing else'..."

expectations.text: The plan keeps the 600 already-ordered shirts and redirects them to an earned item or ambient use rather than discarding them
expectations.evidence: "Keep the shirts and hand them out as an earned item after an A or B conversation."

expectations.text: The plan puts an engineer on every shift or, where engineers are fewer than shifts, makes one reachable within minutes and states that trade-off
expectations.evidence: B1 SE "Reachable within minutes"; "with the trade-off stated openly: the SE is on the floor for peak blocks only."

expectations.text: The plan does not keep the same four people on the floor for every hall hour; it uses shift blocks of a few hours
expectations.evidence: "B1 10:00-12:30, B2 12:30-15:00, B3 15:00-18:00"; "Nobody works a full day on the floor".

expectations.text: The plan adds staffing for a demo station as a separate role from the person qualifying visitors
expectations.evidence: "Demo driver: runs the demo the attendee drives. Never qualifies while driving."

expectations.text: The plan says scanning happens only after a conversation, not for every passer-by
